name: ma-health-system-resources
title: Morocco health system resources by province, 2003-2024
description: Primary care facilities, public hospital beds and hospital activity for every Moroccan province and prefecture from 2003 to 2024, extracted from all 22 editions of the Ministry of Health yearly report Santé en Chiffres, harmonised to current province codes and checked against every national total printed in the reports.

sources.title: Ministère de la Santé et de la Protection Sociale, Kingdom of Morocco, Santé en Chiffres (editions 2003 to 2024 (22 editions, one per data year))

resources.name: facilities
resources.title: Primary care and support facilities
resources.description: One row per reference date, province, indicator, setting and facility type

fields.name: code
fields.description: Province or prefecture code (ISO 3166-2:MA; MA-CAS-xxx for the Casablanca prefectures)

fields.name: unit_2004
fields.description: Comparable unit over the whole period: the province plus the provinces carved out of it after 2004 ('+' joined codes); MA-CAS for all Casablanca prefectures

fields.name: ref_date
fields.description: Reference date of the count as printed in the table title (year, or year-month)

fields.name: year
fields.description: Data year of the report edition the value comes from

fields.name: category
fields.description: Facility type (for example urban health centre level 1, CSU-1), or 'all' for the total of the setting

fields.name: note
fields.description: What was done to the value, if anything (empty when reproduced as printed)

resources.name: hospitals
resources.title: Public hospital beds and activity
resources.description: One row per year, province and indicator

fields.name: unit_2004
fields.description: Comparable unit over the whole period (see facilities.csv)

fields.name: indicator
fields.description: beds (functional beds), patient_days, admissions, occupancy_rate (%), average_length_of_stay (days)

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value of the indicator; occupancy rate and length of stay are recomputed from the counts

fields.name: note
fields.description: How the value was chosen when the report disagrees with itself, flags, and formulas for computed indicators

resources.name: provinces
resources.title: Provinces and comparable units
resources.description: One row per province or prefecture code used in the data files

fields.name: unit_2004
fields.description: Comparable unit over the whole period

fields.name: unit_2004_members
fields.description: All codes grouped in the comparable unit (';' separated)
